title: Visual Screenshot Navigation & Inspection
characteristics: Uploads targeted screenshots (cropped components and full interfaces) to convey visual intent.
Directs the agent to reverse engineer specific visual sections visible in the image.
Expects the agent to map visual elements (labels, reviews, ratings, checkboxes, green tick marks) to underlying DOM nodes.
emulator_guideline: When the user provides screenshots, treat them as the primary visual specification. Cross-reference visual features with live DOM trees to locate corresponding selectors.
